changes.after: The FMO controls changed only the fast correlation time at fixed component variances and slow correlation time: one compared 4.04 with 4.56 fs, and a separate low/high control compared 3.79 with 4.56 fs. These were counterfactual variants of the recovered two-component FMO covariance model, not exchanges between observed FMO cases, PYP intermediates or docking poses. The lifetime-and-intensity nuisance construction used the 4.04 versus 4.56 fs pair.

changes.before: Useful discrimination already supplied by the constrained static comparator defeats the proposed incremental temporal benefit.
changes.after: Useful discrimination supplied by the constrained static comparator does not by itself establish or exclude an incremental temporal benefit. For the specified PYP parameters and width statistic, no usable temporal increment has been demonstrated; that limited result does not exclude other observables or parameter regimes (Branch-2 entry 72). Any proposed temporal increment must survive the uncertainty and nuisance comparison before it can support an additional benefit.
